title: Week in Orbit
summary: The space and defense sectors are grappling with production bottlenecks while major players like SpaceX continue to make headlines with their financial maneuvers. Meanwhile, new partnerships and budget allocations hint at a shifting landscape in space resilience and tactical capabilities.

themes.title: Missile Production Challenges
themes.body: The push for increased missile production is hitting a snag due to solid rocket motor shortages. This bottleneck could delay not just production timelines, but also strategic initiatives.

themes.title: Artemis Lunar Plans Evolve
themes.body: Revised plans for the Artemis lunar lander are taking shape, reflecting ongoing adjustments to meet ambitious timelines. This could signal a more pragmatic approach to lunar exploration, though skepticism remains.

themes.title: SpaceX's Financial Surge
themes.body: SpaceX's shares surged nearly 20% following its historic IPO, making Elon Musk the world’s first trillionaire on paper. This financial windfall may bolster further investments in ambitious projects, but the sustainability of this growth remains to be seen.

themes.title: Budget Boost for Space Resilience
themes.body: The FY27 budget markup includes a $1.4 billion increase for space resilience initiatives, reflecting a growing recognition of the strategic importance of space. This funding could enhance capabilities but also raises questions about prioritization in a crowded defense budget.
